purpose: Teach: キャッチボール/プーチン/チャングム/ビクトリア/ヨコ/東海道/ゴア/ナビゲーション

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、お父さんとキャッチボールしてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were out in the yard throwing a ball with your dad.
lines.style: Light observation. Slight lilt at the end like she's testing whether he'll deny it. Playful, not accusatory. Warm edge underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会でプーチン政権習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You covered Putin's regime in social studies, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Quick pivot back. A little defensive but disguised as curiosity. Matches her tempo. Slight emphasis on the random-ness of the example, like he's not letting her get comfortable.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族でチャングム観てたな
lines.en: Riku, you watched that Korean drama with your family last week.
lines.style: Continues the observation game. Gentle prodding. She's not backing down. Slight teasing in the rhythm — she knows he heard the last one.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、世界史でビクトリア女王習ったろ?桜
lines.en: You learned about Queen Victoria in world history, right Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her rhythm now. He's gotten into it. Still self-conscious but committed to the pattern. Slight stumble in the middle like he's reaching for examples.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、教室のヨコ列に座ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were sitting in that back row in class today.
lines.style: Escalating the game slightly. More confident now. She knows he's watching her. Quick, observant delivery. Almost teasing in its specificity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で東海道線使ったろ?桜
lines.en: You took the Tokaido line on the school trip, didn't you Sakura?
lines.style: Fully into it now. Faster pace. He's figured out the pattern and is playing along naturally. Less hesitation, more rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でゴア元副大統領習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, your history class covered Vice President Gore, didn't it?
lines.style: Keeping the momentum. She's enjoying this exchange now. Slight grin in her voice. The absurdity of the examples is becoming part of the game.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自転車にナビゲーション付けてたな、桜
lines.en: You had a GPS mounted on your bike, remember Sakura?
lines.style: Closer, more intimate. He's dropped some of the self-consciousness. Softer delivery. The game has become something else — something between them.
